description: Performance ads. Rejects a conversion while it is on hold: nothing is paid for it and its amount returns to the ad's budget. reject_code is one of duplicate, fraud, bonus_abuse, chargeback, terms_violation, other; other needs a reject_note of 10 to 500 characters.

ad_id.description: The id of an ad of this account.

api_key.description: The API key of the account (can_live_...). Optional when this MCP connection sends it as the Authorization: Bearer header.

conversion_id.description: The id of a conversion (cnv_...), from list_ad_conversions.

name: reject_conversion
title: Reject a held conversion
